title: The map connected to your experiences but also a part of all of us
content: Many of us have been to this mall world. It’s not just based on when/where you were raised. It really is a low vibrational state of being that can be beneficial for your spiritual growth as scary as it is. It’s about your inner psyche. It shows you all of your indiscretions, the things you struggle with in your waking life, embarrassments, your confidence levels among others. We all visit some form of this place based on the things we encounter as problems in our waking life Anytime I visit mall world it’s apocalyptic, end of the world I’m always fighting entities or trying to save lives among being chased by multiple antagonists
